purpose: Implement the shared application update transaction above replaceable platform installers: verify exact authenticated artifact bytes, snapshot canonical creative state, explicitly stop the owned runtime, prevent concurrent profile mutation, execute package change once, reopen and integrity-check the same Headquarters, and either settle success or compensate package plus exact creative snapshot without laundering ambiguous outcomes into success.

lineage.outcome: A normal N0TE application can attempt an authenticated update without gambling the Artist's current durable work: package success requires real post-update Headquarters validation, known changed failures compensate, and ambiguity remains explicit recovery work.
lineage.capability: Authenticated application update transaction with creative-state rollback

legacy_rejections: two updates mutate one profile concurrently
Song changed after snapshot but old update still installs
snapshot restored before package rollback is proven
update journal hash without legal state-machine validation

completion_proof: prepare requires the exact process that owns a RUNNING ApplicationRuntime, verifies authenticated target artifact bytes, creates a canonical recovery snapshot, reaches STOPPED and rechecks logical database truth before persisting PREPARED

only one unresolved/prepared update may exist per profile and package mutation also requires the normal profile runtime lease, preventing a second app runtime from editing the profile during maintenance
apply re-verifies manifest, target and artifact bytes, re-inspects the exact snapshot and rejects if live logical creative state differs from the prepared snapshot before any package callback
INSTALLING is durably written before the package driver callback; package callbacks return request-bound receipts with explicit resulting release identity
UNKNOWN/exception install outcomes become RECOVERY_REQUIRED with no blind retry or automatic rollback
FAILED_SAFE settles only when the package receipt proves the original release remained installed
FAILED_CHANGED or clean post-update validation failure rolls the package back first and restores the exact prepared creative snapshot only after rollback is proven SUCCEEDED
rollback failure/UNKNOWN or restore failure becomes RECOVERY_REQUIRED and never claims compensation
successful install settles only after the real same-profile Headquarters opens, passes SQLite quick_check/foreign_key_check and closes cleanly
if post-update Headquarters cannot prove canonical database release, the consumer-safe guard records RECOVERY_REQUIRED and forbids automatic rollback underneath a potentially open database
journal integrity validates legal lifecycle transitions and request-bound receipts; recomputing only the envelope hash cannot make PREPARED->SUCCEEDED valid
crash-visible in-flight states are requires_recovery=true and retry_allowed=false
settled outcomes release both profile maintenance and update-coordination ownership before terminal success/failed-safe/rolled-back truth
